chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: Dawn light breaks through dark clouds above a river and green reeds.

storyPlacements.title: The First Disciples and the Wedding at Cana
storyPlacements.alt: Jesus speaks with servants beside large stone water jars at a wedding.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: Six stone water jars stand in a shaded courtyard beneath grape vines.

storyPlacements.title: Cleansing the Temple and Nicodemus
storyPlacements.alt: Nicodemus speaks with Jesus on a rooftop terrace by lamplight.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: A clay lamp lights two empty cushions on a roof at night.

storyPlacements.title: The Woman at the Well
storyPlacements.alt: A Samaritan woman holding a water jar speaks with Jesus beside a well.

storyPlacements.title: Healing at Bethesda
storyPlacements.alt: A man holds his rolled sleeping mat beside Jesus at the pool of Bethesda.

storyPlacements.title: Bread of Life
storyPlacements.alt: Jesus teaches listeners seated on stone benches in Capernaum.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: Leafy booths stand on stone terraces beneath a clear autumn sky.

storyPlacements.title: The Woman Caught in Adultery
storyPlacements.alt: A woman stands before Jesus in a quiet courtyard as others walk away.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: Early light casts long shadows across an empty stone temple court.

storyPlacements.title: The Man Born Blind
storyPlacements.alt: A man washes his face at a stone pool beneath Jerusalem’s terraces.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: An open wooden gate leads into a stone sheep pen among green hills.

storyPlacements.title: Jesus at the Feast of Dedication
storyPlacements.alt: Jesus speaks with listeners beneath a temple portico on a cool winter day.

storyPlacements.title: The Raising of Lazarus
storyPlacements.alt: Lazarus stands with his sisters and Jesus outside a garden tomb.

storyPlacements.title: Anointing and Triumphal Entry
storyPlacements.alt: Mary brings a small perfume jar to Jesus during a meal at Bethany.

storyPlacements.title: Jesus Washes the Disciples' Feet
storyPlacements.alt: Jesus kneels beside a basin and washes Peter’s feet as disciples watch.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: Open rooms face a quiet garden courtyard beneath a blue evening sky.
Imagined scene: Clusters of purple grapes hang from green branches on a thick vine.
Imagined scene: Sunlight breaks through rain clouds above a calm lake and distant hills.
Imagined scene: Stars appear above a quiet roof terrace with olive branches at dusk.

storyPlacements.title: Arrest, Trial and Crucifixion
storyPlacements.alt: Joseph and Nicodemus carry linen and spice jars toward a garden tomb.

chapterImages.alt: Imagined scene: Linen cloth and a clay jar rest on a stone tomb bench.

storyPlacements.title: The Resurrection Appearances
storyPlacements.alt: Mary Magdalene turns toward Jesus in a quiet garden beside the tomb.

storyPlacements.title: Breakfast by the Sea of Tiberias
storyPlacements.alt: Jesus prepares fish and bread as fishermen come ashore beside the lake.
